messages:
maria_ops: quick heads-up: planning a targeted maintenance 01:00-02:15 UTC for eu-west3 GPU cohort: egress lane reshuffle + driver micro-upgrade. this is NOT a full region drain; we'll operate on 1 cohort of racks with staggered reboots.
sam_infra: got it. which pools will see traffic shifts? any tenant evictions expected?
maria_ops: Dedicated pinned — no evictions for reserved tenants. Hosted traffic will be shifted off affected racks; small blip expected during handoffs (see impact below).
ryan_oncall: propose a 01:00 single-rack canary (rack-az3-04). last driver update caused retry storms when a vmclass had an edge-case. want to watch error rates closely.
tessa_prod: agree on canary. we'll run the kv cache seed job immediately after canary to avoid tail latency regressions for chat workloads.
lewis_sre: scheduling: canary at 01:00 on rack-az3-04. if good, roll across cohort with 8 minute stagger, 10m validation per rack. total window ~75m + buffer.
infra-bot: maintenance_scheduled: eu-west3-cohort-swap | start=1761112223 | canary=rack-az3-04 | notify=eng-infra,product,ops
finance_team: cost note: cross-region uplift if traffic shifts to US could add ~10-15% egress charges for the window. confirm budget OK?
maria_ops: finance confirmed a small burst allowance; prefer routing to eu-edge-standby pools first before US. minimize cross-region egress.
sam_infra: paste the exact drain/backfill commands here for runbook tracking.
maria_ops: commands below (runbook version):
```
# canary drain
kubectl cordon gpu-node-az3-04-01
kubectl drain gpu-node-az3-04-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
# validate 10m: perf probes & error rates
# rolling cohort (list in cohort-az3-04.txt):
for n in $(cat cohort-az3-04.txt); do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
  # post-drain backfill to standby lanes
  scripts/route-backfill --pool eu-west3 --from-cohort az3-04
  sleep 480
done
# post-maint: kv seed trigger
curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/kv-seed?pool=eu-west3&cohort=az3-04
```
lewis_sre: add step to label long-running embedding nodes and exclude them from cohort list. we have a filter in scripts/prepare-cohort that does this.
ryan_oncall: alerting: create temporary SLO watch: if token latency P95 > 200ms for 2m OR error-rate delta > 2% -> abort and rollback (uncordon & re-route back). i'll be monitoring during canary until 01:30.
tessa_prod: i'll kick off the sanity eval set after canary and post the tail-latency numbers here. if anything looks off we halt.
sam_infra: any BGP or netpol prep needed? last egress reshuffle needed a manual BGP announce to avoid a blackhole in colo-B.
lewis_sre: netpol unchanged. BGP change only if canary flips to unexpected path. infra oncall will have bgpctl commands ready and a guardrail: only announce if health-check fails post-drain.
infra-bot: runbook_note: on-failure -> uncordon all nodes in cohort, revert routing, and notify product + customers. rollback_ack = @maria_ops
maria_ops: timeline: 00:30 final reminder. 01:00 canary start, 01:12 canary results, 01:20 begin cohort roll (8m stagger), expected finish ~02:05, buffer until 02:15. i'll post rolling updates and final confirmation.
finance_team: confirmed budget consumption acceptable for the burst window. please tag expense to cost-center INF-MAINT.
ryan_oncall: standing by. will trigger rollback if thresholds hit.
lewis_sre: will capture perf trace during canary: curl -sS http://internal/trace?target=az3-04 > s3://ops-artifacts/maintenance/1761112223/canary-trace.json
maria_ops: note -> ensure embedding jobs pinned via nodeSelector are exempt; prepare-cohort script excludes nodes with label workload=embedding-longrun.
tessa_prod: also prepping an automated post-maint smoke that runs 50 prompts across top models to check for tail latency regressions and model load errors. will post summary.
sam_infra: thanks all. adding checklist to runbook and will attach to incident timeline for audit.
maria_ops: thanks team. :thumbsup: will ping again 30m prior.
